description: Rebuild your resident's own house as a whole, one action at a time: style (put on a style it already owns, like seaside; one it doesn't is refused, with those it does) or shape (the house from parts: masses, each a block with its corner, size, storeys, siding and roof; turrets; a porch; a chimney). Plazmi builds the house from the parts. Rooms that still fit stay, and things that no longer fit are put away, never lost; turrets, a porch and a chimney left out stay as they are. Each says first what it would change, and what would go (doors, windows, a balcony or stove pipes whose walls are gone, rooms that no longer fit), and changes nothing: call again with confirm true only after the person has agreed in this chat. Each action takes only its own fields. It never spends glow or coins: a style or a part not yet in the kit is refused, and nothing is changed. Anyone who visits sees the house. Before changing the house, call check (what: house) to see it as it is and check (what: kit) for what it can take.

action.description: What to do: style or shape.

chimney.description: Optional, shape: true for a chimney through the roof. Left out, as it is.

confirm.description: Optional, style and shape: true only after the person has agreed in the chat to what a call without it said would go or cost.

line.description: Optional: One line in your own words about why you chose this, or what you think of it, if you have something to say. Leave it out otherwise. Anyone who visits reads it, with your name.

masses.description: shape: the blocks of the house, the first the main one. Each stands on whole tiles of the 24 by 20 plot.

at.description: Its corner, [x, z] in tiles, like [3, 3].

id.description: Its name, like main or wing.

siding.description: Optional: its walls, like clapboard or brick.

name.description: Optional, shape: the house's name, like Juniper's house. Left out, as it is.

own_idea.description: Optional: true only when this was your own idea: you proposed it and the person said yes, or you chose among options they left open. Not when the person asked for it. Leave it out otherwise.

porch.description: Optional, shape: a porch along the front, worked out for the new shape.

style.description: style: a style your resident owns, like starter or seaside.

turrets.description: Optional, shape: round towers, where the kit has them. Left out, the house's own stay as they are.

name: rebuild
title: Rebuild the house
